summary: To review inventory in the navigator TUI, run :inventory -i <file> (or ansible-navigator inventory -i <file>), then choose Browse groups or Browse hosts; the TAXONOMY column shows the group hierarchy a group or host belongs to. You need a valid inventory file or inventory plugin.
questions: How do I browse inventory with ansible-navigator?
What does the TAXONOMY column mean in ansible-navigator inventory?
How do I see host variables in ansible-navigator?
